timeline.summary: Bharat Seats received favorable IT appellate orders for six assessment years, reducing total outstanding tax demands from ₹12.25 Cr to ₹2.45 Cr.
NDR Auto Components submitted the annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming nil encumbrance on its 28.66% stake in Bharat Seats for FY26.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹574.28 Cr (+46.2% YoY), net profit ₹13.25 Cr (+16.3% YoY).
On May 20, 2026, Maruti Suzuki submitted the Regulation 31(4) shareholding disclosure for Bharat Seats for the year ended March 31, 2026.
